bundle.shortDescription: Uploads ForeverCollect SavedVariables from World of Warcraft: Forever to ForeverDB
bundle.longDescription: Desktop uploader for the SavedVariables of the ForeverCollect addon. Detects the World of Warcraft: Forever client (Wine, Lutris, Faugus, Bottles, Windows), watches its ForeverCollect.lua and uploads every new write to the ForeverDB ingress automatically; every upload keeps an archive copy. Classic, Classic Era and Retail are not supported yet.
